_comment: Human-approved alias resolutions. Decisions as data, with approver and evidence. Any name a machine cannot resolve is FLAGGED, never guessed; a human ruling is recorded here and becomes the written trail. Pattern approved 2026-07-28. roster_admissions records teams ADMITTED to a roster-locked state by league authority; alias decisions resolve NAMES, admissions add MEMBERS. merges records duplicate team rows collapsed by human ruling; alias decisions resolve NAMES, admissions add MEMBERS, merges remove DUPLICATES.

decisions.basis: human-approved, explicitly NOT a machine inference
evidence: exactly one Bainbridge HS exists in WA, located on Bainbridge Island
the WHSBLA schedule's own Location field reads 'Bainbridge HS'
production already carries a bainbridge_island_wa row seeded from a7-classification.json
LaxNumbers class page v=3583 (3A) lists 'Bainbridge Island'

decisions.basis: human-approved: WHSBLA export names an existing Oregon co-op by its short name
evidence: OHSLA canonical name is the co-op 'Aloha/Southridge'
Oregon's 41-team roster is curated and roster-locked; this is an alias, not a new team

decisions.basis: human-approved: EXPORT TYPO — 'Calderra' has a doubled r
evidence: OHSLA canonical name is 'Bend/Caldera' (one r)
LaxNumbers Oregon feed also lists 'Bend/Caldera'
no school named 'Calderra' exists; this is a transcription error in the league export

decisions.basis: human-approved: WHSBLA export names an existing Oregon co-op by its short name
evidence: OHSLA canonical name is the co-op 'Clackamas/Nelson', slug 'nelson'
Oregon roster is locked; this is an alias, not a new team

decisions.basis: human-approved: alias, NOT a rename — the canonical name stays 'Claremont Secondary'
evidence: existing row claremont_bc is named 'Claremont Secondary' (from a7-classification)
WHSBLA export uses the short form; short form becomes an alias and the canonical name is untouched

roster_admissions.name: Vashon
roster_admissions.basis: league authority — roster membership changes come from the league, not from inference
evidence: appears in Brandon Fortier's official WHSBLA 2027 draft classification file
the roster lock worked as designed: it surfaced a membership change for a ruling instead of auto-creating
no 2026 rows anywhere — Vashon was not a 2026 member
roster_admissions.reversal_rule: if the October final list drops Vashon, it is removed the same way it arrived — by league authority

merges.basis: same school reached from two directions by two sources; pre-dates the roster lock
evidence: Brophy College Preparatory, Phoenix AZ — universally shortened to 'Brophy Prep'
brophy_az seeded from a7-classification.json as an OREGON opponent, name 'Brophy College Prep'
brophy_prep_az seeded from the WHSBLA 2026 export as a WASHINGTON opponent, name 'Brophy Prep'
both rows are state=AZ; neither has team_seasons or ranking_entries
brophy_az holds the only game reference (Sunset @ Brophy College Prep, 2026-03-21)
merges.keep_rationale: brophy_az holds the game FK and carries the school's full canonical name
merges.note: Non-curated states have no roster lock, so nothing prevented this. Merging is a prerequisite gate before AZ rankings are ever enabled.
